ascendants.name: The Iron Sovereign
ascendants.motivation: Believes resource extraction proves dominance. Every planet stripped is a throne earned.

ascendants.name: The Void Architect
ascendants.motivation: Constructs impossible geometries from extracted materials. Sees planets as raw data to compile.

ascendants.name: The Signal Weaver
ascendants.motivation: Maintains the frequency. Not for BIT. Not for AXIS. For the signal itself.

ascendants.name: The Deep Current
ascendants.motivation: Flows through systems that predate AXIS. Does not explain. Does not need to.

_note: Models must have a real walk clip (gun_robot's Run is a tumble with root motion; it stood the Void Architect on its side and rolled it). Enemy Ascendants are announced when a wave clears and come with the next wave, walking the maze to the Spire as a boss: towers, BIT and the Spire can hit them, the friendly rival answers friendly_delay seconds later and fights them, and one that reaches the Spire takes spire_damage_share of its health and leaves. damage is per hit on the rival; towers and BIT take damage * tower_damage_share. hp grows by hp_per_wave for each wave past min_wave; walk_speed is the enemy's speed on the maze (speed is the friendly's).
